question: What encasement and spiritual fruit characterize this ten-syllabled mantra?
premises: This mantra is enclosed by Bhuvaneśī.
This mantra bestows great Sarasvatī power.
inference: The mantra, encased by Bhuvaneśī, grants great mastery of speech.
plain_english: This mantra, enclosed by Bhuvaneśī, bestows great power of Sarasvatī.
